name: Maeveen O'Donagh
description: Saves Yunnie from a jump and accompanies him.

timeline.summary: Maeveen O'Donagh's troop hides pikes in the grass to face a cavalry charge.
timeline.quote: we faced them with swords drawn and pikes hidden in the grass at our feet

citation.text: Pikemen (The Dark, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Maeveen O'Donagh is made to stand helpless as his whole troop is killed.
timeline.quote: standing there helpless as they killed my whole troop

citation.text: Word of Binding (The Dark, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Vervamon's party visits the apparently abandoned city and suffers terrifying prophetic dreams before leaving.
timeline.quote: The party abandoned the city the next day.

citation.text: "City of Shadows", section "Dark Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maeveen O'Donagh saves Yunnie from jumping at Merfolk Vista.
timeline.quote: Saved by Maeveen O'Donagh at the last second

citation.text: "Yunnie", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yunnie refuses a marriage alliance, smashes the Sigil of Iwset and abandons the city.
timeline.quote: Yunnie refused, smashing the sigil and abandoning the city to its fate
